demonstratedDefect: Normal UI changed shared page/filter before awaited reads. On failure old rows/labels remained visible but bounds and subsequent Refresh/navigation used the failed destination. Empty-page fallback also decremented shared page before its read could fail.
fix: Keep destination filter and page, including optional one-page fallback, provisional until every required read succeeds. Preserve the prior committed view on failure. Existing mutation acknowledgements/errors, exact-key writes, busy/disposal guards and fallback depth are unchanged.
